_doc: Linux (`platform: linux`) entries for libserver.so. The builds record is the sha256 the judge
(sigupdate.py check --platform linux) compares a new build's libserver.so against. The CSource2Server
entries measure the Source2Server001 object's table (its length and the GameFrame slot the bridge hooks
through KHook) against the generated ISource2Server; the bridge takes the object from CreateInterface and
the slot from s2sdk_sys, not an RVA from here. Nothing here has a `bridge` macro.

CSource2Server.via: libserver.so 0x19b33e3 (build 2000930) in the static initializer 0x19b23c0 that registers Source2Server001: lea rax,[rip+vtable] (the CSource2Server address point 0x2667ba8, header {offset-to-top 0, typeinfo _ZTI14CSource2Server}) is stored into the singleton qword_29F33C0 (the object CreateInterface("Source2Server001") returns), then add rax,0x350 gives the secondary table at object+0x28. No `_ZTV` symbol is exported for the class
CSource2Server.notes: ISource2Server implementation (the Source2Server001 interface), primary table, offset-to-top 0; followed by a one-slot secondary table (offset-to-top -0x28, same typeinfo)

VTLEN_CSource2Server.via: libserver.so address point 0x2667ba8 (build 2000930): 104 .text slot pointers up to the secondary table's header {-0x28, _ZTI14CSource2Server}
VTLEN_CSource2Server.notes: Itanium length of ISource2Server's implementation, compared by sdkcheck.py with the generated Itanium length of ISource2Server (103): the interface's 103 slots plus one entry GCC adds for CSource2Server's override of its secondary base (slot 103 = a ret-only function, the secondary table's one slot is a ret-only function too)

CSource2Server::GameFrame.via: libserver.so CSource2Server primary vtable slot 19 = 0x19926d0 (build 2000930): opens the VProf scope "GameFrame" at ./gameinterface.cpp:1041, takes three bools (sil, dl, cl), the third gates the autosavedangerousissafe path - the same body as the Windows CSource2Server::GameFrame
CSource2Server::GameFrame.notes: ISource2Server::GameFrame(bool simulating, bool bFirstTick, bool bLastTick); its slot is the generated ISource2Server_slots::GameFrame (19, Itanium) - Linux entries carry no `sdk`, the slot index is the vslot's
